Fix stream/iterator lifecycle handling in RxJS. Both normal and scheduled readable-stream consumption must cancel the underlying reader exactly once on early consumer closure when cancel exists,and always release the lock even if cancellation rejects. Natural exhaustion releases without canceling. Older reader objects without cancel must remain usable; an optional cancel method may be added to ReadableStreamDefaultReaderLike,preserving existing members. Scheduled async iterable consumption must have at most one pending next(),return the iterator exactly once on early unsubscribe,stop further pulls,and deliver next() rejections to the subscriber without unhandled promise rejections.
